title: CODEX® Multiplexed Imaging Overview
author: Diane Saunders
materials: Label tissue with primary antibodies and prepare reagents for imaging. CODEX® Multiplexed Imaging | Tissue Staining and Reporter Plate Preparation by Islet and Pancreas Analysis Core ⓘ See also: Akoya Biosciences PhenoCycler™ User Manual

steps.title: Fix tissue with PFA
steps.instruction: Fix pancreas samples in 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) solution.

steps.title: Embed tissue for cryosectioning
steps.instruction: Embed the fixed tissue in either Optimal Cutting Temperature (OCT) medium or carboxymethylcellulose (CMC) prior to cryosectioning.

steps.title: Section and mount on coverslips
steps.instruction: Cut 10 µm cryosections, place them onto microscope coverslips, and store the mounted coverslips at –80 °C for up to 2 months.

steps.title: Design antibody panel
steps.instruction: Create a multiplexed antibody panel using a mix of pre‑conjugated primary antibodies and/or custom‑conjugated primary antibodies.

steps.title: Acquire cyclic fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Perform cyclic fluorescent imaging of the tissue sections on the appropriate CODEX microscope.

steps.title: Process raw imaging data
steps.instruction: Using CODEX Processor v1.8.1.9 (Akoya Biosciences, as of May 2022), process the raw image files to perform image stitching, z‑plane selection, background subtraction, deconvolution, and shading correction.

steps.title: Optional: Register with other modalities
steps.instruction: If desired, register the CODEX images with other imaging modalities (e.g., autofluorescence registration) following the HuBMAP data‑processing guidelines.
